subject: general
question: What is the primary purpose of the Raksha Kavach system showcased by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) on Republic Day, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Multi-layered defence protection**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Raksha Kavach system**, developed by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**, is a state-of-the-art technology designed to provide **multi-layered defence protection**.
 
• This system integrates a combination of **advanced sensors, radar systems, and intercepting mechanisms** to protect critical assets and military installations.</
